'''Interference Pulse Stabilizers''' were [[Droid/Legends|droid]] components used in several models of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. Both the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] and [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] models incorporated Interference Pulse Stabilizers in their designs.<ref name="EGTD" />
